meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 把文本或 Markdown 整理成带 frontmatter 的结构化 Markdown,修正引号与中英文间距,另存为「原文件名-formatted.md」;已是 Markdown 时先问你要优化、保留原样还是只修排版。
howto.when: 当你说「格式化 Markdown」「美化文章」「添加排版」等指令,或要求改善文章版式时触发。

say.text: 把这份纯文本整理成带 frontmatter 的 Markdown。
say.note: 会生成新文件并补充标题、摘要等元信息。

say.text: 帮我格式化 draft.md,保留原样,只修正引号和中英文间距。
say.note: 会另存副本,不改动原文件。

say.text: 这篇 Markdown 已有结构,我要优化排版,输出 formatted 版本。
say.note: 会按完整流程整理并另存新文件。

howto.what_en: Converts plain text or Markdown into structured Markdown with frontmatter, headings, bold, lists and code blocks; fixes quotes/spacing; saves as {filename}-formatted.md. If input is already Markdown, it asks whether to optimize, keep original, or just fix typography.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout.

say_en.text: Format this plain text as Markdown with frontmatter.
Format draft.md, keep original content, just fix quotes and spacing.
say_en.note: Saves a copy without changing the original.

say_en.text: This file is already Markdown; optimize it and output a formatted version.
